videos.title: You Are Using AI Backwards
videos.hook: Most people use AI completely backwards.
body: They ask for final answers first.
That is the slowest workflow possible.
AI works better like a teammate.
Start with your messy raw thoughts.
Then ask for the final version.
Now the output sounds like you.
And it takes way less time.
videos.cta: Save this before your next prompt.
videos.thumbnail_prompt: Vertical thumbnail, cinematic close-up of a glowing AI chat window split into chaos on one side and clean organized notes on the other, bright cyan interface light on a dark background, one human hand pointing at the transformation, high contrast, ultra crisp, no text

videos.cta: Save this for your next work spiral.

videos.title: Why Raises Never Feel Rich
videos.hook: Raises do not fix broke habits.
body: Better food, faster shipping, newer phones.
videos.cta: Save this before your next raise.
videos.thumbnail_prompt: Vertical thumbnail, stack of cash melting into shopping bags and app icons, dramatic contrast between wealth and impulse spending, rich green and gold accents on a dark background, polished social-media realism, no text

videos.title: Repetition Feels Like Truth
videos.hook: Repetition feels like proof to your brain.
body: That is the illusory truth effect.
Hear something often, trust it faster.
Your brain swaps familiarity for evidence.
That is why feeds shape beliefs.
videos.cta: Share this with your group chat.
videos.thumbnail_prompt: Vertical thumbnail, human profile silhouette filled with repeated glowing words spiraling inward, one bright checkmark forming from repetition, surreal psychology visual, deep shadows with electric blue highlights, ultra detailed, no text

videos.title: Your Feed Rewards Emotion
videos.hook: Your feed is not showing best content.
body: Sticky means fast emotion, fast reaction.
It does not check your wellbeing.
videos.cta: Send this to your most online friend.
videos.thumbnail_prompt: Vertical thumbnail, smartphone screen pulling colorful emotional icons like magnets into a feed, explosive red and cyan reaction bursts, dark cinematic background, sleek tech aesthetic, hyper-detailed, no text

videos.title: Typing Is The Slow Way
videos.hook: Typing is the slowest way to use AI.
body: Talk first, prompt later with AI.
Dump the messy thought out loud.
That is why it feels easier.
Use your voice like draft mode.
videos.cta: Save this before your next brainstorm.
videos.thumbnail_prompt: Vertical thumbnail, person speaking into a phone as glowing waveform transforms into neat task lists and polished text, futuristic AI assistant vibe, moody dark background with bright cyan audio glow, crisp modern realism, no text

videos.title: Free Apps Are Not Free
videos.hook: Free apps are rarely actually free.
body: The product is not the app.
That is why tracking feels endless.
Privacy settings matter more than branding.
